title: Customer granary: unfiltered requests and context notes — Aug 2026
content:
Purpose and framing:
This is a working stash of raw customer threads, short verbatim notes, and lightweight proposals. Goal: create a fast route from frontline signals to scoped implementation experiments (quickpatches) and a small set of medium-term projects.

Context: recent wave of feedback (Jul–Aug 2026) from 8 enterprise pilots + 20 self-serve power users. Signals are heterogeneous — some operational (latency/cost), some feature asks (routing, fallbacks), some compliance/PKI for Private. Document is intentionally unpolished; capture the texture of customer language.

Topline clusters (ranked by frequency + near-term impact):
1) Cold-start / short-sequence latency variance (high frequency, high urgency)
   - Customers: multi-tenant SaaS, fintech pilot, healthcare POC
   - Voices: "First token takes unpredictably longer after quiet periods"; "cold starts kill interactive flows"
   - Context: hosted API spike after inactivity; dedicated pools OK but sometimes suffer slow warmup when VMs rebind
   - Quickpatch idea: aggressive lightweight KV pre-warm for last-used models per org + keep-alive probe on warm idle slots (opt-in)
   - Ticket proto: JIRA/INF-4321 (warmup-probes + idle-keepalives)

2) Cost attribution and per-route visibility (medium freq, high impact for procurement)
   - Voices: "We need per-route cost per 10k tokens for budget owners"; "embedding batch costs vs gen costs unclear"
   - Context: finance teams ask for CSV exports and per-API-key charge breakdowns
   - Quickpatch: exportable per-route daily CSV + sample Grafana dashboard with token buckets mapped to route tags
   - Longer: integrate route-level cost tagging into Console (filter by model, quantization profile)

3) Dedicated capacity autoscaling granularity (dedicated customers)
   - Voices: "When traffic spikes from experiments, bursts overshoot reserved capacity and we get throttles"; "need burst credits"
   - Context: reserved pools are coarse-grained; customers want micro-burst windows and easier burst purchase/authorization
   - Proposal: add "burst credit" pool with configurable spend limit per month, plus predictive autoscaler ramp for canary traffic patterns

4) Observability: token-level traces and prompt lineage (developer-facing ask)
   - Voices: "We need to trace bad responses to exact prompt/route and model version"; "helpful to triage hallucinations across rollouts"
   - Quickpatch: add route+model version tagging to existing traces and show top-10 user prompts by failure rate in Console
   - Privacy note: ensure obfuscation options for PII in traces for Private/VPC customers

5) Private deployment onboarding friction (security/compliance)
   - Voices: "KMS integration is painful; we need HSM support and clearer cert rotation docs"; "audit logs format differs from our SIEM"
   - Ask: sample terraform module + SAML/KMS integration checklist + audit-log mapping examples
   - Proposal: Private onboarding kit (automated cert rotation script + SIEM mapping templates)

6) Embeddings drift and batch retrain cadence (product/ML ask)
   - Voices: "We see embedding similarity decay after 3 months for doc corpora"; "how often should we refresh?"
   - Quick guidance: recommend refresh cadence by TTL buckets (hot/medium/cold) and offer auto-recompute job with delta pricing estimate

Representative verbatim snippets (copied from support threads, lightly anonymized):
- "When our agents idle for >40m the next user message sometimes waits 2–3s extra. UX is fragile."
- "If you could show us top 5 routes by spend for the last 7 days we'd be golden."
- "We had an outage when the dedicated autoscaler collapsed — we need a plan B that still serves at degraded perf."

Immediate low-effort patches (2–4 week dev):
- CSV export: per-route daily usage and cost (backend + Console front-end) -> owner: CS -> Infra/Console PR (github PR: 998)
- Warmup probe daemon for dedicated pools (opt-in toggle) -> owner: serving-runtime -> ticket INF-4321
- Trace tag enrichment: model_version, route_id, api_key_owner -> owner: observability team -> small schema change + UI column
- Private onboarding checklist doc + sample terraform module -> owner: solutions-eng -> doc-only deliverable, quick

Medium scope / roadmap candidates (quarterly):
- Burst credit/reserved augmentation product (commercial + infra changes)
- Console: per-route cost explorer + cost alerts + budget tokens
- Eval-driven rollback: tie quality monitors to rollouts for auto-safety net (if eval metric drops by X, automatically revert)
- HSM/KMS managed offering for Private (needs legal + security sign-off)

Open questions for triage meeting (Sept 6):
- What latency budget do we make public for hosted API vs dedicated? Can we commit to a warmup SLA?
- Data minimization: what level of prompt tracing is acceptable for enterprise customers vs compliance needs?
- Pricing model for burst credits (pre-pay vs overage)?
- How do we surface embedding refresh costs without scaring customers? (show estimated cost per reindex)

Suggested next steps (owner assignments):
- CS: assemble a 2-page Private Onboarding Kit draft (due Sep 10) -> Asha + Tom
- Infra/Serving: scope warmup-probe POC (2 sprints) -> Nina
- Console: prototype per-route CSV export and simple daily cost endpoint -> Elliot
- Product: schedule tradeoff sync for burst-credit economics (include sales + finance)

Appendix: quick mapping to tickets & PRs mentioned in threads (working):
- INF-4321 (warmup-probes) — baseline design doc attached in Confluence link above
- INF-1123 (cost-export) — customer request thread + example CSV schema
- github.com/redwood/inference/pull/998 — early front-end for route export (WIP)
- Linear LIN-5543 — onboarding checklist task

Notes-to-self (raw):
- Keep this doc living; update with fresh verbatim quotes daily for first week after triage.
- Prioritize patches that reduce time-to-resolution for customers (traces + CSV are high ROI).
- Validate warmup-probe non-intrusiveness with SRE before wide rollout.

End of notes.
